entries.title: II Chronicles 13:1
segments: In the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam began Abijah to reign over Judah.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:2
segments: Three years reigned he in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:3
segments: And Abijah joined battle with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men: and Jeroboam set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, who were mighty men of valor.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:4
segments: And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim, which is in the hill-country of Ephraim, and said, Hear me, O Jeroboam and all Israel:

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:5
segments: Ought ye not to know that Jehovah, the God of Israel, gave the kingdom over Israel to David for ever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:6
segments: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, rose up, and rebelled against his lord.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:7
segments: And there were gathered unto him worthless men, base fellows, that strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tender-hearted, and could not withstand them.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:8
segments: And now ye think to withstand the kingdom of Jehovah in the hand of the sons of David; and ye are a great multitude, and there are with you the golden calves which Jeroboam made you for gods.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:9
segments: Have ye not driven out the priests of Jehovah, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and made you priests after the manner of the peoples of [other] lands? so that whosoever cometh to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams, the same may be a priest of [them that are] no gods.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:10
segments: But as for us, Jehovah is our God, and we have not forsaken him; and [we have] priests ministering unto Jehovah, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites in their work:

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:11
segments: and they burn unto Jehovah every morning and every evening burnt-offerings and sweet incense: the showbread also [set they] in order upon the pure table; and the candlestick of gold with the lamps thereof, to burn every evening: for we keep the charge of Jehovah our God; but ye have forsaken him.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:12
segments: And, behold, God is with us at our head, and his priests with the trumpets of alarm to sound an alarm against you. O children of Israel, fight ye not against Jehovah, the God of your fathers; for ye shall not prosper.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:13
segments: But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them: so they were before Judah, and the ambushment was behind them.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:14
segments: And when Judah looked back, behold, the battle was before and behind them; and they cried unto Jehovah, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:15
segments: Then the men of Judah gave a shout: and as the men of Judah shouted, it came to pass, that God smote Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:16
segments: And the children of Israel fled before Judah; and God delivered them into their hand.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:17
segments: And Abijah and his people slew them with a great slaughter: so there fell down slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:18
segments: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied upon Jehovah, the God of their fathers.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:19
segments: And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Beth-el with the towns thereof, and Jeshanah with the towns thereof, and Ephron with the towns thereof.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:20
segments: Neither did Jeroboam recover strength again in the days of Abijah: and Jehovah smote him, and he died.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:21
segments: But Abijah waxed mighty, and took unto himself fourteen wives, and begat twenty and two sons, and sixteen daughters.

entries.title: II Chronicles 13:22
segments: And the rest of the acts of Abijah, and his ways, and his sayings, are written in the commentary of the prophet Iddo.
